title: trips.v1 value
description: What the Outbox Event Router sends: the Kafka key is the trip_key, and these fields come from outbox columns via table.fields.additional.placement (id:envelope:event_id, type:envelope:event_type, occurred_at:envelope:occurred_at), so they cost no extra WAL. The key is JSON-quoted ("abc"): parse it as JSON. Held to real messages in contracts/tests.

event_id.description: UUIDv5 of (trip_key, type): silver drops repeats

occurred_at.description: Microseconds: a TIMESTAMP without zone, as Debezium encodes it

payload.description: The event's JSON payload, as text; parse it by event_type
